2609.03800.title: Govern the Model, Not Only the Data: Storage, Circulation, and Learning in Creative AI
2609.03800.paper_summary: Federated learning is increasingly presented as a privacy-preserving advance: personal data remain on the device, and only model updates are shared. It borrows the vocabulary of the federated social web, yet inverts its logic, distributing computation while the resulting model stays with whoever convened the training. We argue that federation is not in itself a remedy for extractive AI, because outcomes depend on who governs the data and the model and who has agency over the practices that shape them. We describe three layers at which a creative community can hold its work: storage, circulation, and learning. Examining artist-governed trusts, cooperatives, and consent infrastructures, we show that creator governance is established at storage and circulation but stops at learning: contributors can consent to training, yet have little say over the resulting model or its federation. We map the research space this opens, pairing technical open problems with the human questions from which they unfold. We propose four design principles for a creative data commons that governs models and their federation, not only datasets: govern the model, not only the corpus; make the terms legible at the moment of contribution; design for refusal as a first-class state; and decide stewardship in the open and account for it.
2609.03800.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習越來越被視為一種保護隱私的進步：個人數據保留在設備上，只有模型更新被共享。它借用了聯邦社交網絡的詞彙，但顛覆了其邏輯，分配計算的同時，結果模型仍然留在召集訓練的個體手中。我們主張，聯邦本身並不是解決剝削性人工智慧的良方，因為結果取決於誰管理數據和模型，以及誰對塑造它們的實踐擁有主導權。我們描述了創意社群可以持有其工作的三個層面：儲存、流通和學習。檢視藝術家管理的信託、合作社和同意基礎設施，我們顯示創作者治理是在儲存和流通層面建立的，但在學習層面停滯：貢獻者可以同意訓練，但對結果模型或其聯邦幾乎沒有發言權。我們描繪了這一研究空間，將技術上的開放問題與其展開的人類問題配對。我們提出了四個設計原則，以治理模型及其聯邦，而不僅僅是數據集：治理模型，而不僅僅是語料庫；在貢獻時使條款清晰可見；將拒絕設計為一種一級狀態；並在公開中決定管理權並對其負責。
